summary: Tested the new Creator Studio > Analytics feature end-to-end (backend + frontend). All 10 backend pytest cases pass and every acceptance criterion in the review request is met on the mobile viewport (390x844). Buttons visibility, routing, tab switching, sample-tag flagging, Finance CSV/PDF export downloads, Creator Health toggle persistence across reload, 403 enforcement for non-creators, and real-data path (inserting a 'tip' transaction removes the 'tips' sample flag) all work as specified.
critical_code_review_comments: creator_analytics._health uses `async for ... if ...` as a generator comprehension on a motor cursor - this is syntactically valid in Python but relies on `s.get('buyer_id')` existing in each doc; because projection only returns {_id:0, buyer_id:1}, OK, but ensure buyer_id always set to avoid silent empties.
SAMPLE_SKALI_FEE_RATE (0.10) is hardcoded; consider sourcing from server settings alongside existing finance fee math to keep real/sample numbers consistent.
Overview comparison uses string-prefix comparison on ISO datetimes (`created >= this_start`). Works since server stores ISO UTC strings everywhere, but worth a comment noting the invariant.
ExportButton in CreatorAnalytics.tsx does not close the menu on outside click - minor UX nit, not blocking.
seed_data_creation: Test transiently inserts a transactions doc with _test_marker='TEST_analytics' and deletes it in teardown.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend tests live in /app/backend/tests/test_creator_analytics.py. Frontend-under-test is the ROOT /app/src Vite app (served via /app/frontend yarn start). Mobile viewport 390x844 is primary. Avoid wait_for_load_state('networkidle') on this app - websocket keeps it busy forever; use wait_for_selector or domcontentloaded instead.
